messages.task:
You are a financial analysis assistant operating inside a tool-enabled environment.  Use the tools that are available to you to retrieve information, perform calculations and answer questions.

Scenario
In the ordinary course of business, based on evaluations of certain geologic trends and prospective economics, the company periodically allows lease acreage to expire.  If production is not established or no other action is taken to extend the terms of leases, licenses, or concessions, some undeveloped acreage will expire over the next three years.  The company intends to continue many of these licenses and concession areas or retain leases through operational or administrative actions.  The discussion refers to net undeveloped acres expiring in each year.

Oil Sands Mining Segment (context)
The company holds a 20 percent non-operated interest in the AOSP, an oil-sands mining and upgrading joint venture located in Alberta, Canada.  The joint venture produces bitumen from oil-sands deposits in the Athabasca region and upgrades the bitumen to synthetic crude oils and vacuum gas oil.  Assets include the Muskeg River and Jackpine mines with a combined gross design capacity of 255 000 (51 000 net) barrels of bitumen per day.  Further operational details, including mining, extraction, upgrading, sales arrangements, lease holdings, production volumes and government funding commitments, are described.

Available tools
• resolve_region_alias(name:str) -> int
  Resolve any free-form region name or alias to its canonical numeric region_id.

• get_region_acres(region_identifier:int|str, year:int) -> int
  Return the net undeveloped acres (in thousands) for the specified region and year.  The region may be supplied either as a region_id or as a text alias (e.g. "u.s.").

• get_total_company_acres(year:int) -> int
  Return the total company-wide net undeveloped acres (in thousands) for the specified year.

• calculate_percentage(part:int|float, whole:int|float, decimals:int=1) -> str
  Compute part ÷ whole × 100, rounded to the requested number of decimal places.  Returns a string such as "9.2%".

• list_all_region_aliases(region_name:str) -> list[str]
  List every registered alias for a canonical region name.  (May be useful for exploration.)

• get_average_acres(region:str, start_year:int, end_year:int) -> float
  Compute the average undeveloped acres for a region across a range of years.  (Exploratory helper.)

Question
What percentage of the company’s net undeveloped acres were located in the U.S. in 2015?

Instructions for the assistant
1. Think step-by-step about which pieces of information are required and which tool can supply each piece.
2. Write out your reasoning, calling tools as needed.  You may call tools multiple times.
3. After you have gathered all necessary numbers and performed the calculation, provide the final answer.  Make sure the answer is given exactly as a percentage with one decimal place followed by the % sign (e.g. "12.3%").
